subject: english
title: 七下英语同步章节卷 · Units 7–8
label: Units 7–8 A Day to Remember · Once upon a Time
unit: 七下·Units 7–8 A Day to Remember / Once upon a Time
source: 人教版七年级下册 Unit 7 A Day to Remember、Unit 8 Once upon a Time：一般过去时（be 动词 was / were、规则与不规则动词、否定和疑问）、过去时间状语、讲述经历和故事、时间顺序词。按初一单元测试题型编写（不含听力），百分制

items.stem: I ______ to the Great Wall with my parents last summer.
items.exp: last summer 是过去时间，用一般过去时；go 的过去式是 went。

items.stem:
—Did you have a good time at the party?
—______. It was really fun.
items.exp: Did ...? 用 did / didn't 回答；后面说很好玩，用肯定回答。

items.stem:
—What ______ you do last weekend?
—I visited my grandparents.
items.exp: last weekend，一般过去时的特殊疑问句用 did＋主语＋动词原形。

items.stem: Last night my father told me a story. It ______ me laugh a lot.
items.exp: 讲的是昨晚的事，用过去式 made。

items.stem: Once upon a time, there ______ a poor farmer in a small village.
items.exp: Once upon a time 讲过去的故事；a poor farmer 是单数，用 was。

items.stem:
—Where were you yesterday afternoon?
—I ______ at the science museum.
items.exp: yesterday afternoon，主语 I，be 动词过去式用 was。

items.stem: We ______ TV last night. We played chess.
items.exp: 一般过去时否定：didn't＋动词原形。坑点：didn't 后面不能再用过去式。

items.stem: She ______ the heavy box upstairs yesterday.
items.exp: yesterday 用过去式；carry 以“辅音字母＋y”结尾，变 y 为 i 加 -ed。

items.stem:
—How was your trip to Hangzhou?
—______
items.exp: How was ...? 问“……怎么样”，回答感受。坐火车回答的是 How did you go there?

items.stem: The fox ______ the meat from the crow and ran away.
items.exp: and 连接的另一个动词 ran 是过去式，前后一致，take 的过去式是 took。

items.stem:
—When did you get to Beijing?
—______
items.exp: 问过去什么时候到的，用“时间段＋ago”回答。for two days 回答 how long。

items.stem: Mozart started to write music ______ he was only five years old.
items.exp: 他五岁的“时候”开始写音乐，用 when 引导时间状语。

items.stem: At first the boy didn't believe the story, but ______ he found it was true.
items.exp: at first 起初……in the end 最后……前后对应。

items.stem:
—I lost my wallet on the bus yesterday.
—______
items.exp: 听到不好的消息表示同情：That's too bad / I'm sorry to hear that。

items.stem: The little girl was very ______ because she lost her way in the forest.
items.exp: 在森林里迷路了，很害怕 scared。

sections.title: Mia and the Little Bird
sections.passage:
Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Mia. She lived with her grandmother near a big forest. Every day, Mia (16) water from the river for her grandmother.
One morning, Mia went to the river as usual. On her way, she (17) a little bird under a tree. Its wing was hurt and it couldn't (18). Mia felt sorry for it. She carefully picked it up and (19) it home.
For two weeks, Mia gave the bird food and water every day. Slowly, the bird got (20). One sunny morning, it flew out of the window. Mia was a little (21), but she was happy for the bird, too.
A year later, Mia's grandmother got very ill. The doctor said she needed a special flower from the top of the mountain. But the mountain was very high and Mia didn't know the (22). Just then, a bird flew to her window and sang. It was the little bird! It flew in front of Mia, and Mia (23) it up the mountain. Finally, she found the flower.
Her grandmother got well soon. From then on, Mia always (24) one thing: when you help others, they may help you (25).

items.exp: 住在河边，每天为奶奶从河里提水：carried water。
在路上发现一只小鸟：found。
翅膀受伤了，飞不了。
小心捧起，带回家：take sth. home。
照顾了两周，伤慢慢好了，后来飞走了：got better。
but 转折：小鸟飞走了有点难过，但也为它高兴。
后面小鸟在前面带路，说明 Mia 不认识路：didn't know the way。
小鸟飞在前面，Mia 跟着它上山：followed。
从那以后，她一直记着一件事：remembered。
肯定句句末表示“也”用 too；either 用于否定句；also 一般不放句末。

groups.label: A
groups.title: A School Trip
groups.passage:
Saturday, May 10th, Sunny
Today our class went on a school trip to the City Science Museum. We met at the school gate at 8:00 a.m. and took a bus there. It took us about 40 minutes.
First, we visited the space hall. We saw a real spacesuit and learned how astronauts eat and sleep in space. Then we went to the robot room. A robot played chess with me, and I lost! At 12:00 we had lunch in the museum café. I had a sandwich and some orange juice.
In the afternoon, we watched a 3D film about the ocean. It was really exciting. Before we left, I bought a model rocket at the gift shop for my little brother. It cost 35 yuan.
We got back to school at 4:30 p.m. I was tired but happy. It was a day to remember!

items.stem: How did the students go to the museum?
items.exp: took a bus there。

items.stem: What time did they get to the museum?
items.exp: 8:00 出发，路上约 40 分钟，大约 8:40 到。

items.stem: What did the writer do in the robot room?
items.exp: A robot played chess with me。

items.stem: What did the writer buy for the little brother?
items.exp: I bought a model rocket at the gift shop for my little brother。

items.stem: Which of the following is TRUE?
options: The writer won the chess game.
They watched a film about the ocean.
They got back to school at 4:00 p.m.
items.exp: we watched a 3D film about the ocean。下棋输了（I lost）；午饭在博物馆咖啡厅；4:30 回校。

groups.label: B
groups.title: Tu Youyou
groups.passage:
Tu Youyou was born in Ningbo, Zhejiang in 1930. When she was a teenager, she got very ill and had to stop school for two years. Then she decided to study medicine. She wanted to help sick people.
After university, she worked at the China Academy of Traditional Chinese Medicine in Beijing. In 1969, she and her team started to look for a new medicine for malaria. Malaria was a terrible disease, and it killed many people every year. They looked at more than 2,000 old Chinese recipes. Finally, an old book by Ge Hong gave her an idea, and her team got artemisinin from a plant called qinghao.
Before they used the medicine on patients, Tu Youyou and her workmates tested it on themselves. It was safe and it worked well. The medicine saved millions of lives around the world.
In 2015, she won the Nobel Prize. She was the first Chinese woman to win a Nobel Prize in science.

items.stem: Why did Tu Youyou decide to study medicine?
options: Because she wanted to help sick people.
Because she wanted to win prizes.
items.exp: She wanted to help sick people。

items.stem: When did she start to look for a new medicine for malaria?
items.exp: In 1969, she and her team started to look for a new medicine for malaria。

items.stem: What gave her the idea?
options: An old book by Ge Hong.
items.exp: an old book by Ge Hong gave her an idea。

items.stem: What did Tu Youyou and her workmates do before they used the medicine on patients?
items.exp: tested it on themselves。

items.stem: What kind of person was Tu Youyou?
items.exp: 研究了 2000 多个古方，坚持多年；为了安全先在自己身上试药，说明勤奋又勇敢。

sections.title: My Winter Holiday
sections.passage:
Last winter holiday, my family (36) (go) to Harbin. It (37) (be) very cold there, but we had a great time. On the first day, we (38) (visit) the Ice and Snow World. There (39) (be) many beautiful ice buildings. At night, the lights (40) (make) them look like a dream.
On the second day, I learned (41) (ski). At first I fell down many times, but I didn't (42) (give) up. In the end, I could ski down a small hill (43) (quick). I took lots of (44) (photo) and sent them to my friends. I will never (45) (forget) this trip.

items.exp: Last winter holiday，go 的过去式 went。
主语 It，be 的过去式用 was。
规则动词过去式加 -ed。
There be 就近原则：many beautiful ice buildings 是复数，过去时用 were。
讲过去的事，make 的过去式 made；make sb. / sth. do 使……做。
learn to do sth. 学做某事。
didn't 后接动词原形：give up 放弃。
修饰动词 ski 用副词 quickly。
lots of 后接可数名词复数；photo 直接加 -s（不是 -es）。
will 后接动词原形。

sections.prompt:
每个人都有难忘的一天。请以“A Day to Remember”为题写一篇短文：1. 那是什么时候、你和谁在哪里；2. 按时间顺序写出你们做了哪些事（至少三件）；3. 那一天为什么让你难忘。要求：60 词左右，题目已给出，不计入总词数；文中不得出现真实姓名和校名。
A Day to Remember
points: 按顺序写出至少三件事
写出难忘的原因或感受
语言正确（一般过去时、不规则动词、first / then / in the end 等顺序词），书写规范
sections.sample:
A Day to Remember
Last Sunday was a day to remember. My parents and I went to the countryside to visit my grandparents.
First, we picked strawberries in Grandpa's garden. Then Grandma taught me how to make dumplings. My dumplings looked funny, but they were delicious! In the afternoon, we went fishing by the river, and I caught a big fish.
In the end, we drove home at six. I was tired but very happy because I learned a lot and spent a great day with my family.
sections.exp: 写完检查：叙述过去的事全文用一般过去时；常见不规则动词 go→went、take→took、teach→taught、catch→caught、make→made；用 first、then、after that、in the end 把事情串起来。
